overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Live figures from real orders, products and stock. Nothing here is estimated.
overview.startText: The store is empty. Add your first product, then publish it to make it visible to customers.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Create products, set real prices and stock, then publish.
products.emptyText: Add your first product. Prices and stock are entered by you — nothing is pre-filled.
products.results: {count, plural, =0 {No product} one {# product} other {# products}}

form.createHint: The product starts as a draft. Add at least one variant, then publish it.

fields.name: Name
fields.skuHint: Capital letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Must be unique.
fields.slugHint: Leave empty to generate it from the English name.

form.nameRule: Fill in at least one language; the others fall back to it.
form.needsVariant: Add at least one variant before publishing.

variants.title: Variants, prices & stock
variants.text: Prices are in OMR with up to 3 decimals. A variant without a price cannot be sold.

hints.price: Leave empty if the price is not decided yet.
hints.compareAt: Shown struck through; must be higher than the price.
hints.cost: Private. Used for margin analysis only.

images.title: Images
images.text: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, up to 8 MB. Each image is optimised automatically.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order with its real payment and delivery state.

picker.hint: Up to {max} products. The first one feeds the product block of the ad.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Ads shown on the home page, categories and product pages. Statistics are recorded on the server.
campaigns.newHint: Texts in the three languages, media, dates and where the ad appears. Starts inactive unless you activate it.
campaigns.editHint: Changes go live on the store within a few minutes (cache).
campaigns.statsNote: Impressions = ad at least 50% visible, counted once per visit; clicks = call-to-action clicks. Last 14 days.
campaigns.deleteText: Its media and statistics are removed too. This cannot be undone.
campaigns.previewHint: Exactly as the store renders it. Preview views are not counted.

hints.internalName: Only visible in the admin centre.
hints.sceneKind: Used by the 3D scene type (CSS animation, light on phones).
hints.mediaIMAGE: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, up to 8 MB. Optimised to WebP and AVIF automatically.
hints.mediaVIDEO: MP4 or WebM, up to 10 MB. Add a poster image.
hints.mediaSCENE_3D: No file needed: the scene is drawn by the store.
hints.mediaMobile: Optional. For images a phone-sized version is generated automatically.
hints.poster: Shown before the video plays and when motion is reduced.
hints.linkUrl: Store path such as /category/smartphones, or an https:// address. Empty = first linked product.
hints.dates: Muscat time. Leave empty for no limit.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.subtitle: Reviews come from verified purchases and are shown only after you publish them.
reviews.search: Text, product SKU or customer email
reviews.results: {count, plural, =0 {No review} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
reviews.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {none waiting} one {# waiting} other {# waiting}}
reviews.emptyPending: No review is waiting for moderation.
reviews.publishText: It becomes visible on the product page and counts in the product rating.
reviews.rejectText: It will not be shown on the site. The decision is recorded in the audit log.

zones.title: Zones & rates
zones.subtitle: The shop only promises what is set here. A zone without a standard fee is shown as not configured and cannot be ordered to.
zones.standardFeeHint: Leave empty while delivery to this zone is not ready.
zones.freeFromHint: Optional order amount. Empty = never free.
zones.capacityHint: Orders per day. Empty = no limit.
zones.expressAvailable: Offer express delivery in this zone
zones.expressFeeHint: Added on top of the standard fee.
zones.capacityExpressHint: Required for express: orders per day.
zones.weightHint: Optional. Applied above the included weight.
zones.readOnly: You can view the rates but not change them.

fulfilment.title: Preparation & delivery
fulfilment.none: No delivery yet: it is created when the payment is confirmed.
fulfilment.readOnly: You can follow the delivery but not change it.
fulfilment.markPackedConfirm: Is the parcel packed and ready for a courier?
fulfilment.redispatchConfirm: Put this parcel back in the queue for a courier?
fulfilment.unassignConfirm: Take this delivery back from the courier?
fulfilment.assignHintPacked: The customer is told that the order is on its way.
fulfilment.assignHintEarly: The courier is reserved now; the delivery starts once the parcel is packed.
fulfilment.withCourier: The parcel is with the courier. Hand-over is confirmed in the courier workspace with the customer's code.
fulfilment.failHint: The customer is notified. The parcel can be sent out again afterwards.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.subtitle: People who deliver orders. A courier linked to an account sees their deliveries in the courier workspace.
couriers.emptyText: Add a courier to be able to send orders out.
couriers.open: {count, plural, =0 {no delivery in progress} one {# delivery in progress} other {# deliveries in progress}}
couriers.deactivateText: They can no longer be assigned new deliveries.
couriers.addText: Name and mobile are shown to the team when assigning a delivery.
couriers.name: Full name
couriers.accountHint: The e-mail the courier signs in with, to use the courier workspace.

import.title: Import a catalogue
import.subtitle: Load a list of models as drafts. You then check each one and add its real variants, prices, stock and photos.
import.fileHint: A list of models (id, brand, series, model, year, colours, capacities, official source). 2 MB at most.
import.batchHint: Kept on each product so you can find what came from this file.
import.done: {total, plural, one {# model read} other {# models read}}.
import.doneDetail: {created} created as drafts, {refreshed} already present (notes refreshed, nothing else changed).

rules.drafts: Every model is created as a draft. Nothing is published.
rules.noVariants: No variant is created: the colours and capacities of the file are only candidates, kept as notes to verify on the official page.
rules.noPrices: No price, stock, promotion or photo is ever set by an import.
rules.idempotent: Importing the same file again creates no duplicate and never overwrites what you edited.

packs.title: Ready-made packs
packs.text: Packs shipped with the site: models, finishes, capacities and one studio image per finish.

names.iphone-visuals-2026: iPhone 13 to 18 — models and studio images

packs.summary: {models} models · {images} images · checked by the pack author on {date}
packs.done: Pack imported: {variants} variants and {images} images added. Everything is a draft without price or stock.
packs.nothingNew: This pack is already imported: nothing new to add.
packs.failed: The import stopped. You can start it again: it resumes where it stopped.
packs.note: No price and no stock are set. Each product stays a draft until you price it, stock it and publish it.

importNotes.title: Imported model: to verify
importNotes.warning: These colours and capacities are candidates from the import file, not verified facts. Check the official page for your market, then create only the variants that really exist. Nothing here is shown to shoppers.

pricing.gridText: Enter the real price, previous price, cost and stock of each variant. Nothing is saved until you press Save; a variant without a price cannot be bought.
pricing.noVariants: This product has no variant yet.
pricing.saveCount: Save {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
pricing.fillCapacityHint: Copy price, previous price and cost to the {count} variant(s) with the same capacity ({capacity})
pricing.fillAllHint: Copy price, previous price and cost to all {count} variants
pricing.reasonHint: Recorded in the stock movement history (optional).
pricing.pending: {count, plural, one {# row changed — not saved yet} other {# rows changed — not saved yet}}
pricing.hint: Leave a price empty while it is not decided: the variant stays "price coming soon".
pricing.importSubtitle: Export the variants to complete, fill them in a spreadsheet, check the file, then apply it.
pricing.exportText: A CSV with one line per variant. Only the SKU column is required when you import it back.
pricing.exportNote: {products} product(s) still need at least one price.
pricing.importText: Load or paste the CSV. A dry run shows every change and every refused row before anything is written.
pricing.importRules: Columns: sku (required), priceOmr, compareAtOmr, costOmr, stock. An empty cell leaves the value unchanged; to remove a price, edit it in the grid.
pricing.importApply: Apply {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
pricing.importApplyHint: All or nothing: one audited transaction.
pricing.importFixErrors: Fix the refused rows, then check again.

summary.errors: {count, plural, =0 {No error} one {# error} other {# errors}}

errors.compare_not_higher: Previous price must be higher than the price
errors.below_reserved: Stock is lower than the quantity reserved by orders
errors.stock_invalid: Stock must be a whole number
errors.too_large: The file is too large (2 MB maximum)
errors.no_value_column: No priceOmr, compareAtOmr, costOmr or stock column found
errors.malformed: The file could not be read as CSV

verified.title: Verified catalogue 2026
verified.text: Models, colours, capacities and specifications taken from the official manufacturer pages (checked on 2026-11-12).

rules.facts: 46 of 48 models verified on official pages; 2 stay "to verify" (no official page found).
rules.variants: Variants (colour × capacity) are created only where the source confirms them: all Apple finishes in every capacity, and each real Samsung SKU. HONOR and OPPO stay drafts until you confirm the combinations.
rules.noPrice: No price, stock, photo or review is ever created. Variants without a price show "price coming soon" and cannot be bought.
rules.drafts: Safe to run again: existing products, prices, stock and your edits are never overwritten.

verified.publish: Also publish the fully verified models
verified.publishHint: They appear in the shop with "price coming soon" until you enter real prices. You can archive any of them afterwards.
verified.doneDrafts: {awaiting} draft(s) waiting for the colour × capacity check, {unverified} model(s) without an official page.
